These four unmodified Godot 4.5.2 NuGet packages come from the official .NET editor distribution, whose archive was verified against the release SHA512 manifest. They provide the SDK, source generator, runtime API and editor API; NuGet.Config uses only this local source. This allows restoration without Internet after installing the .NET SDK and Godot .NET editor. Godot is MIT licensed; the license text is in GODOT-LICENSE.txt, and package metadata is contained in the packages. The engine/editor and .NET SDK are prerequisites, not bundled here.
